text:
lost track how many times I've gotten this pitch

"sleepy industry + rollup + AI rips out all the cogs/opex"

have to wonder what inning this strategy is in (I don't know)

positives:

-must look amazing in Excel

-sexy-sounding pitch, probably not too hard to whip up a deck ("mid-teens IRR%") and then go raise $

negatives:

-classic "MBA-type underestimates complexity of biz" + "yeah so that human is actually necessary and not just an opex line item you can hardcode to 0" + crafty seller SDE snowjob

-too much capital in this strategy --> pushes up purchase price multiples --> depresses IRR

best guesses:

-AI in general can be 1st-3rd inning while something like this is late innings

-I'm a stupid public markets guy so if I know about it, usually 7th-9th inning

-if recent MBA grads are doing it, 7th-9th inning

TL;DR shrug slash probably good time to be a SMB seller
